title: HeriKGQA: Grounded Knowledge-Graph Question Answering over Cultural Heritage Sensor Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.15904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cultural heritage sites are increasingly monitored by sensor networks, but querying their data requires database expertise. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a natural-language interface, yet over raw sensor records they lose track of which sensor, site, and time each value belongs to, and silently miscompute. We present HeriKGQA, a knowledge-graph question-answering method that confines the LLM to interpreting questions and phrasing answers, leaving computation to SPARQL and deterministic code. translated_title: HeriKGQA：面向文化遗产传感器数据的接地式知识图谱问答
translated_abstract: 文化遗产遗址正越来越多地由传感器网络进行监测，但查询这些数据需要数据库专业知识。大型语言模型（LLM）虽然提供了自然语言接口，但在处理原始传感器记录时，它们无法追踪每个数值所属的传感器、遗址和时间，从而悄然产生错误计算。我们提出HeriKGQA，这是一种知识图谱问答方法，它将LLM限定于解读问题和组织答案，而把计算留给SPARQL和确定性代码。问题被解析为受文化遗产本体约束的意图，该本体将W3C SOSA/SSN与CIDOC-CRM对齐；随后意图被编译为SPARQL，答案则由查询结果以及接地层推导出的时间、空间和异常事实共同生成，且每个LLM步骤都有纠错机制把关。在基于五个文化遗产遗址真实数据的500个问题上，HeriKGQA达到了99.0%的准确率，比使用相同LLM的三个基线中最强的一个高出18.2个百分点。
tldr: HeriKGQA通过将LLM限定于理解问题和组织答案、把实际计算交给SPARQL和确定性代码，并结合文化遗产本体、接地事实层与逐步纠错机制，在五个遗产遗址的真实传感器数据上实现了99.0%的问答准确率。
en_tdlr: HeriKGQA confines the LLM to interpreting questions and phrasing answers while delegating computation to SPARQL and deterministic code, achieving 99.0% accuracy on real cultural heritage sensor data through a heritage ontology, a grounding layer, and step-wise error correction.
